translation: If the injury is severe and internally connects to the brain and marrow and injures the spirit and intelligence, there must be deep dullness and unawareness of people, and food and drink not taken in; if moreover the qi and blood are both deficient in ordinary times, it must be an untreatable condition. <ins>Ba Xian Xiao Yao Tang (八仙逍遙湯)</ins> Specially washes injuries from falls and blows, hard swelling and pain, and all conditions of cold, trembling, wind-damp, and soreness and pain of the sinews, bones, flesh, blood, limbs, and body. Saposhnikovia (防風), schizonepeta (荊芥), chuanxiong (川芎), licorice (甘草, each one qian), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine), phellodendron (黃柏, each two qian), Maoshan atractylodes (茅山蒼朮), moutan bark (牡丹皮), Sichuan pepper (川椒, each three qian), sophora root (苦參, five qian). Combine all together, put in a white cloth bag, tie the mouth, boil in water until rolling, and fumigate and wash the affected area.
